en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modernist four‑storey public building seen through trees in the foreground. The façade is symmetrical, with large vertical windows and a recessed entrance with columns. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street and across a forecourt, suggesting an institutional or cultural facility, likely a library or university building.
